human_tolerance.notes: A regular visitor to wooded gardens, parks and suburbs, where it takes seed from feeders and scouts from cover before darting in.

phases.name: breeding
phases.note: Pair-forming and nesting in a natural cavity, an old woodpecker hole or a nest box; average clutch size is five to seven eggs.

phases.name: caching
phases.note: During the fall and winter the tufted titmouse hoards food.

vocalizations.description: A clear, whistled 'peter-peter-peter', which the species delivers in about 20 noticeably different ways.
Short, harsh scolding notes given when the bird is agitated, and answered quickly when another bird nearby is disturbed.

range.note: A small songbird native to eastern North America; its range has been expanding northwards since the second half of the twentieth century.

traits.limb_count.note: Biped: two legs; the wings are not counted as limbs.

traits.locomotion_modes.note: Gathers food from the ground and from tree branches and flies between perches.

traits.nest_type.note: Nests in a hole in a tree: a natural cavity, a nest box, or sometimes an old woodpecker nest.

traits.mass_kg.note: EltonTraits BodyMass-Value 21.6 g converted to kilograms.

traits.mass_range_kg.note: Judgement band either side of the EltonTraits mean; no allow-listed open source states the mass range for this species.

traits.length_m.note: Body length of 14-16 cm; the midpoint of that range is used.

traits.wingspan_m.note: Midpoint of the 20-26 cm wingspan given on Wikipedia.

traits.lifespan_y.note: Wikipedia gives a lifespan of roughly 2.1 years, though individuals can live more than 10 years.

traits.diet.note: EltonTraits Diet-Inv 60 mapped to 'invertebrate', Diet-Seed 40 split between 'seed' and 'fruit', because Wikipedia describes the bird as consuming berries, nuts, seeds and small fruits, and separately states that nearly two-thirds of the annual diet consists of insects. The insect share therefore follows EltonTraits rather than being split further.

traits.social.note: Judgement: a pair is the usual unit, with family groups and small feeding flocks of up to about six outside the breeding season. No allow-listed open source quantifies group size for this species.

traits.activity_pattern.note: EltonTraits Nocturnal 0; Wikipedia describes a diurnal bird that is active and vocal through the day.

traits.defense.note: Flies from an approaching threat, usually back to cover; judgement mapping to the schema's single-value field.

traits.wariness.note: Judgement: it scouts a feeder from cover before flying in, so it is cautious but readily habituated to garden feeders.

habitat.use.note: EltonTraits ForStrat-Value gives ground 20 / midhigh 40 / canopy 20 / understory 20; the arboreal share is the sum of the midhigh, canopy and understory strata.

habitat.shelter_tag.note: Roosts and nests in tree cavities.

habitat.resources.note: Food weights follow traits.diet; the nesting and leaf-litter weights are judgement, since no open source gives their relative use.

habitat.human_tolerance.note: Wikipedia lists gardens, parks and shrublands among its habitats and describes its feeder-scout-and-return pattern.

seasonal.strategy.note: A permanent resident of the eastern United States, with no migration.

seasonal.phases.note: Clutch size, cavity nesting and the fall and winter food-hoarding are from Wikipedia; the breeding window itself is authored judgement, since no open source gives egg dates for this species.

seasonal.life_stages.note: No allow-listed open source gives a nestling period for this species; the 60-day juvenile window and the 0.85 scale are authored judgement.

vocalizations.song.note: The 'peter-peter-peter' song and its variability are stated on Wikipedia. No open source gives frequency bands, so freq_hz is omitted.

vocalizations.scold.note: Wikipedia states only that the species is vocally active and responds to sounds of agitation in other birds; it does not describe this call. The wording of the scolding notes is authored, and the cooldown is authored judgement.

look.note: Colours from Wikipedia's description: grey upper body, white front, rust-coloured flanks, a black forehead and a grey tufted crest. The proportions and the crest and forehead boxes are authored judgement to render the crest and the dark forehead.

behavior.note: Authored parameters for the shared perching-songbird program: it flees 5 m to a perch, feeds on seed, sings the peter-peter-peter song and scolds when agitated, and nests in cavities between March and June.
